build.command: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server... --if-present run build && BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/rolodex run build

notes: No root start script; the container starts the @workspace/api-server workspace package (artifacts/api-server/), and the build is scoped to it and its workspace dependencies.
Replit artifacts: @workspace/rolodex is served at / in front of the API.
Replit provisioned a Postgres database; set DATABASE_URL in the environment variables to one this app can reach.
Replit managed Clerk auth; set CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY and CLERK_SECRET_KEY in the environment variables.
